candidates.change_summary: Change the return value from true to false.
Delete the require statement that checks _tos.length > 0, allowing empty arrays to proceed without revert
Delete the inner require(_s) that checks the success of each caddress.call, so a failing subcall no longer reverts the whole transaction
Change the function selector from 'transferFrom(address,address,uint256)' to 'transfer(address,uint256)', altering the called function on caddress
Replace the return value true with false so the function always returns false even on success
